members.resident_use: REACHED, DIRECTLY. resident_main.py:25 imports ResidentAssembly, poll_once and poll_package_once from resident_worker. The resident loop calls poll_once at resident_main.py:65. poll_once (resident_worker.py:859) calls assembly.execute at resident_worker.py:880. ResidentAssembly.execute (def at 639): its already-READY branch calls send_ready_if_ticketed at resident_worker.py:686-687; its fresh-job branch calls worker.run() at resident_worker.py:705, which reaches ResidentGenerationWorker.mark_ready (def at 333; calls at 448 and 504) and then put_state at 341 and self.signal_ready(request_id, record) at 342, whose body (resident_worker.py:345-346) calls send_ready_if_ticketed. reports/resident_installed.py:382 also imports ResidentAssembly from this module. The new function send_ready_if_ticketed is at resident_worker.py:189; it calls send_ready (def at 163) only on the success path (line 200).
members.behaviour_change: REACHED. The I3 signal (analysis_ready, sent through send_ready at lines 163-186) is no longer sent for every READY job. send_ready_if_ticketed (lines 189-200) sends only when BOTH hold: (1) the accepted record carries a non-empty string ticket_id (checked first; otherwise it prints 'IRPT_RESIDENT_READY_SIGNAL skipped=NO_TICKET <request_id>', sends nothing and does not mark i3_sent_at), and (2) record['commentary_requested'] is exactly True (otherwise it prints 'skipped=COMMENTARY_NOT_REQUESTED' and does the same). The READY state write (put_state at line 341) still happens before the signal, so the job state is unchanged. On the re-presented path (lines 686-687) the same gate applies; a skipped send leaves i3_sent_at unset. In plain words: a request with no ticket, or without commentary_requested exactly True, produces no analysis_ready message from this resident.
members.risk_note: A consumer that expects analysis_ready for every READY request (the commentary packager) receives none for un-ticketed requests or requests without commentary_requested exactly True; the pair should name that as the observable change. The signal_ready signature changed (new 'record' parameter); its only closure caller is mark_ready (line 342), and reports/resident_installed.py mentions signal_ready only in comments (lines 48 and 414). No new import, no new environment read, no new AWS call (send_ready's SQS path is unchanged), and no changed default. record is a dict at both call sites (guard() at resident_worker.py:222 and execute at 649); a non-dict record takes the NO_TICKET branch (isinstance check).
